projects.name: Jamestown, North Dakota facility
projects.quote: Our 106 MW facility in Jamestown, North Dakota operated at full capacity during the fiscal year ended May 31, 2024; however, our 180 MW facility in Ellendale, North Dakota experienced a power outage starting in January 2024.

projects.name: Ellendale, North Dakota facility
projects.quote: Our 106 MW facility in Jamestown, North Dakota operated at full capacity during the fiscal year ended May 31, 2024; however, our 180 MW facility in Ellendale, North Dakota experienced a power outage starting in January 2024.

projects.name: Garden City, Texas facility
projects.quote: Additionally, during fiscal year 2024, we increased our energy capacity at our 200 MW Garden City, Texas facility up to 132 MW.

projects.name: Ellendale HPC data center facility
projects.quote: During the fiscal second quarter 2024, we broke ground on our first 100 MW HPC data center facility in Ellendale, North Dakota.

projects.name: Ellendale, North Dakota 400 MW hyperscaler capacity lease
projects.quote: The Company has entered into exclusivity and executed a letter of intent with a US-based hyperscaler for a 400 MW capacity lease, inclusive of our current 100 MW facility under construction and two forthcoming buildings in Ellendale, North Dakota.
